__comment__: Repetition 3 of an 11-point qMT Z-spectrum (sequence qmtspgr_uk, UK_SET). BIDS has no suffix for a Z-spectrum, so MTS is used as the closest available construct; MTS normally denotes the 3-image MTsat protocol. Keys prefixed Saturation* are NOT BIDS fields -- BIDS defines MTState only, with no way to record the saturation flip angle or offset frequency. They are kept here because losing them would make the acquisition unreproducible.
PulseSequenceType: Spoiled gradient echo (SPGR/FLASH) with off-resonance MT saturation
CoilCombinationMethod: Walsh adaptive combination of 32 channels, phase-referenced to the strongest coil
ReconstructionNote: Inverse 2D DFT of the coil-combined k-space. No filtering, no resampling, and no scaling of any kind -- phase is the raw argument of the complex image, in radians on (-pi, pi]. NOTE the companion magnitude WAS intensity-scaled, so the two do not share a scale; divide the magnitude by its MagnitudeScaleFactor before recombining them into a complex image.
OrientationNote: Stored in canonical RAS: array axes are (L-R, A-P, slice) = (88, 128, 1), 2 x 2 x 5 mm. Note the acquisition order was the transpose of this -- readout (128) was the first axis -- so if you transform back to k-space, the readout runs along array axis 1. Plane from the TWIX sNormal (axial); anterior/posterior from the matched DICOM series. LEFT/RIGHT IS A DISPLAY CONVENTION AND IS NOT HEADER-DERIVED -- do not trust the x sign.
